releases.body:
Ports the AgentRouter v2.5.0 recovery fixes to OpenCode.

- Monthly spend is now reported in USD; it was 500,000× too high.
- Mid-stream `response.failed` frames with no error payload get an `upstream_cluster_crash` error.
- Requests identify as `opencode/agentrouter (...)`.
- Interrupted streams retry after 30s, up to 3 attempts.
- Duplicate header entries are collapsed.
- `/agentrouter_check` shows Beijing quota refresh countdowns.
Hide the deprecated built-in `agentrouter` model list so only the plugin's live AgentRouter providers appear.
Fix `Missing required parameter: 'input[N].id'` on Responses models (e.g. gpt-6.1-sol): send history statelessly (`store: false`) and preserve `item_reference.id` during sanitization.

## Changes
- Replace the /agentrouter subcommand interface with separate /agentrouter_status, /agentrouter_pricing, /agentrouter_sync, /agentrouter_check, /agentrouter_pacing, and /agentrouter_key commands.
- Show only GPT 6 Astra, GPT 6.1 Sol, GPT 5.6 Sol, and Claude Opus 5.5 in the model picker. Other model definitions and pricing discovery remain intact.
- Update documentation and CLI help.

Package version: 0.1.2.

Build passed; no tests or live provider requests were run.

## Changes
- Set explicit readable model names in the model picker.
- Preserve OpenCode and AI SDK request headers instead of overriding client identity.
- Retain OpenCode fetch middleware and shared request pacing.

Package version: 0.1.1.

Build passed; no tests or live provider requests were run.
